findings.title: Source-scan test has no defined banned token set or allowlist; existing legitimate dock mutations would fail it or make it vacuous
findings.fix: Ban dock_section/place_section/move_section/float_section/toggle_section/set_section_collapsed/set_section_visible/set_section_height on a dock receiver outside dock_layout.rs, panel_ops.rs and MatrixApp::apply_panel_op. Allowlist reset_to_default, clamp_floats, set_float(PanelId::CommandSearch), set_size and set_visible(PanelId::*) by file. Route the audit user-docked-right hook through apply_panel_op(PanelOp::Dock). Strip comments and strings before scanning.

findings.title: New CMD-history appends from panel ops re-open the proven stale-cursor keystroke drop (Transcript::append_history vs protected_chars)
findings.fix: After every transcript.append_history in the apply_panel_op message path and the +/>> handlers, set focus_cmd = true. Add a frame test: close-box click, then Event::Text('L'), and the draft must equal 'L'. Record the general append_history cursor fix as an out-of-scope caveat.

findings.title: Command outer/inner sync made conditional though the code fixes drift at 6 pt; row metric has no epsilon and is a proxy
findings.where: design.md §4.3 Command size sync, §10.3 item 5, §5.6 command_history_rows
findings.fix: Make the outer sync unconditional: sync_panel_size(CommandLine, panel.response.rect.height()) after show, and make the S26 slack exact. Define command_history_rows = floor((history_height + 0.5) / (r + 2)) with r from TextStyle::Monospace at the live zoom. Assert == 2 at zoom 1.0 and >= 2 at 1.25/1.5.
